about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: Two posts held: the 27 Nov community-question card has overlapping text, and the Cobra Darkspeed LS Driver is posted twice on 27 Nov.
points: 2026-11-27-fri (card): the white 'FULL SWING. NOT FULL PRICE.' line and the gold golfpriceai.com sit on top of the big 'RANGEFINDER OR GPS WATCH?' headline, which makes both unreadable. The card is also dimmed to near-black, so the headline is murky and the colours look muddy. The strapline is unrelated to a community question. Fix: use the clean headline layout as in the thumbnail, with the URL in a clear footer and no strapline over the headline, and keep the card matching the video.

2026-11-27-fri: I could not extract video frames (no ffmpeg in this environment), so only the card and thumbnail were reviewed. The thumbnail itself is strong: 3 big words, a sharp subject, good contrast and a matching palette. Re-check the video end frame after the fix, since the card looks like it came from it.

2026-11-27-moment: the same product, the Cobra Darkspeed LS Driver at £229, is also in 2026-11-27-reactive3 the same day, which breaks the rule that a product must not repeat within 14 days. The two are nearly identical in message. Fix: keep reactive3, which gives the fuller proven price history, and drop or swap this one for a different product.

2026-11-27-reactive3: copy is fine. £419 on 4 Sept to £229 is backed by the site's own price history (home-deals.json). The Pinterest title is empty, so add one, e.g. 'Black Friday, checked: £229 Cobra Darkspeed LS Driver'. The YouTube title is cut off mid-word ('lowest we've tra'), so shorten it.
2026-11-29-hishers: the TikTok caption uses the US spelling hashtag #golfhumor (the others use #golfhumour). Use UK spelling.
2026-12-05-sat: the hook 'You've got 3 seconds.' is mild artificial time pressure. Consider 'No googling.' instead. Not a block.
2026-12-04-fri and 2026-11-27-fri: #golfdeals on a non-deal banter post is off-topic. Drop it.
No card, thumbnail or frames were supplied for the other posts, so they are not visually reviewed. Their captions had no retailer names, no fake urgency and no broken output.
